translations.idiomatic: Kejian failed to detect the forgery. At midnight the rebels rose from within the city and set fire to the Prince of Xiang's palace.

sentences.zh: 克儉倉皇奔救，為賊所執，大罵死。

translations.literal: Kejian rushed in haste to the rescue, was seized by bandits, cursed them loudly, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Kejian rushed to the rescue in panic, was seized by the rebels, cursed them loudly, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 推官鄺曰廣、攝縣事李大覺、遊擊黎民安死焉。

translations.literal: Vice magistrate Kuang Yueguang, Li Dajue who was acting in county affairs, and mobile commander Li Min'an died in the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Vice magistrate Kuang Yueguang, Li Dajue who was acting in county affairs, and mobile commander Li Min'an also died.

sentences.zh: 曰廣，番禺人。

translations.literal: Yueguang was a native of Panyu.
translations.idiomatic: Yueguang was a native of Panyu.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the tenth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the tenth year of the Chongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 居官有守。

translations.literal: In office he was upright and firm.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was upright and resolute.

sentences.zh: 奉檄核軍儲於荊州，甫還任而難作，中刃死，妻子女俱遇害。

translations.literal: Ordered on assignment to audit military stores at Jingzhou, he had just returned to his post when disaster struck; he was cut down and killed, and his wife, son, and daughter all perished.
translations.idiomatic: On orders he went to Jingzhou to audit military stores. He had just returned to his post when disaster struck. He was cut down and killed, and his wife, son, and daughter all perished.

sentences.zh: 大覺，字覺之，金谿人。

translations.literal: Dajue, courtesy name Juezhi, was a native of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Dajue, courtesy name Juezhi, was a native of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉知谷城，兼署襄陽縣。

translations.literal: Through the provincial examination he became magistrate of Gucheng and concurrently acted as magistrate of Xiangyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Through the provincial examination he became magistrate of Gucheng and concurrently served as acting magistrate of Xiangyang County.

sentences.zh: 聞變，系印於肘，縊死堂上。

translations.literal: Hearing of the calamity, he tied the seal to his elbow and hanged himself in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of the disaster he tied the official seal to his arm and hanged himself in the hall.

sentences.zh: 民安，大覺同縣人。

translations.literal: Min'an was from the same county as Dajue.
translations.idiomatic: Min'an was from the same county as Dajue.

sentences.zh: 城中火起，率所部千余人搏戰，矢盡被縛，抗罵死。

translations.literal: When fire broke out in the city he led over a thousand of his men into battle; when arrows were exhausted he was bound, reviled them defiantly, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When fire broke out in the city he led more than a thousand of his men into battle. When his arrows were spent he was bound, cursed the rebels defiantly, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 獨知府夏邑王承曾遁免。

translations.literal: Only Prefect Wang Chengzeng of Xiayi escaped and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Only Prefect Wang Chengzeng fled and escaped unscathed.

sentences.zh: 初，獻忠敗於瑪瑙山，其妻敖氏、高氏被獲，他將搜山，又獲其軍師潘獨鰲，皆系襄陽獄。

translations.literal: Initially, when Xianzhong was defeated at Man'ao Mountain, his wives Lady Ao and Lady Gao were captured; other generals searching the mountains also captured his strategist Pan Du'ao — all were imprisoned in Xiangyang jail.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Xianzhong was defeated at Man'ao Mountain, his wives Lady Ao and Lady Gao were captured. Other generals searching the mountains also captured his strategist Pan Du'ao. All were imprisoned in Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 承曾年少輕佻，每夕托問賊中情形，與獻忠二妻笑語。

translations.literal: Chengzeng was young and frivolous; each evening on pretext of inquiring about conditions among the bandits, he joked and laughed with Xianzhong's two wives.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzeng was young and frivolous. Each evening, on pretext of questioning them about conditions in the rebel camp, he joked and laughed with Xianzhong's two wives.

sentences.zh: 獄吏又多納賊金，禁防盡弛，獨鰲等脫桎梏恣飲。

translations.literal: The jailers also accepted much rebel gold; security was completely lax, and Du'ao and the others shed their shackles and drank freely.
translations.idiomatic: The jailers also accepted large bribes from the rebels. Security was completely relaxed, and Du'ao and the others cast off their shackles and drank freely.

sentences.zh: 嗣昌移牒戒之，承曾笑曰：「是豈能飛至耶？

translations.literal: Sichang sent a dispatch warning him; Chengzeng laughed and said, "Can they fly here, then?
translations.idiomatic: Sichang sent a dispatch warning him. Chengzeng laughed and said, "Can they fly here?

sentences.zh: 」及是，獨鰲果從獄中起，承曾率眾奪門走。

translations.literal: " And when the crisis came, Du'ao did indeed rise from within the jail; Chengzeng led his men and fought their way out through the gate in flight.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis came, Du'ao did rise from within the jail. Chengzeng led his men and fought their way out through the gate in flight.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命逮治。

translations.literal: When this was reported, an order went out for his arrest and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the report reached the court, an order was issued for his arrest and punishment.

sentences.zh: 時河南亦大亂，久逮不至，未知所終。

translations.literal: Henan was also in great disorder at the time; long pursued, he never arrived — his ultimate fate is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was also in turmoil at the time. Pursued for a long time, he was never captured, and his ultimate fate is unknown.

sentences.zh: 徐世淳，字中明，秀水人。

translations.literal: Xu Shichun, courtesy name Zhongming, was a native of Xiushui.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shichun, courtesy name Zhongming, was a native of Xiushui.

sentences.zh: 父必達，字德夫，萬歷二十年進士。

translations.literal: His father Bida, courtesy name Defu, was a jinshi in the twentieth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bida, courtesy name Defu, passed the metropolitan examination in the twentieth year of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 知溧水縣，築石臼湖堤，奏除齊泰姻戚子孫軍籍二十六家。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Lishui County he built the Shijiu Lake embankment and memorialized to remove twenty-six families of Qi Tai's affinal relatives from military registry rolls.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Lishui County he built the Shijiu Lake embankment and memorialized to remove twenty-six families descended from Qi Tai's affinal kin from the military register.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部考功郎中，與吏科給事中儲純臣同領察事。

translations.literal: He rose through transfer to Director of the Ministry of Personnel's Appraisal Section, and together with Chu Chunchen, supervising secretary of the Personnel Section, jointly conducted the evaluation of officials.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive appointments to Director of the Ministry of Personnel's Appraisal Section and, together with Chu Chunchen, supervising secretary of the Personnel Section, jointly conducted the triennial evaluation of officials.

sentences.zh: 純臣受贓吏賕，當大計日，必達進狀請黜純臣，面揖之退，一座大驚。

translations.literal: Chunchen accepted bribes from corrupt officials; on the day of the major evaluation Bida submitted a memorial requesting Chunchen's dismissal, bowed to him face to face and withdrew — the whole assembly was greatly astonished.
translations.idiomatic: Chunchen had accepted bribes from corrupt officials. On the day of the major evaluation Bida submitted a memorial requesting Chunchen's dismissal, bowed to him in person, and withdrew. The entire assembly was stunned.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿丞，陳白糧利弊十一事，悉允行。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and presented eleven points on the advantages and disadvantages of white-grain transport; all were approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and memorialized eleven points on the pros and cons of white-grain transport; the court approved them all.

sentences.zh: 進少卿，巡漕御史孫居相以船壞不治，請雇民船濟運，必達爭止之。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Vice Director; Grain-Transport Censor Sun Juxiang, because the official boats were damaged and unrepaired, asked to hire civilian vessels to keep transport going, but Bida strenuously opposed and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Vice Director. When Grain-Transport Censor Sun Juxiang, finding the official boats damaged and unrepaired, proposed hiring civilian vessels to keep the grain moving, Bida argued against it and blocked the plan.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，以右僉都御史督操江軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi he was made Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to supervise the Caojiang army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianqi reign he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to supervise the Caojiang army.

sentences.zh: 白蓮賊將窺徐州，必達募銳卒會山東兵擊破之。

translations.literal: White Lotus bandit generals were about to strike at Xuzhou; Bida recruited crack troops, joined with Shandong forces, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When White Lotus bandit generals threatened Xuzhou, Bida recruited crack troops, joined forces with the Shandong army, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部右侍郎，以拾遺罷歸，卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Vice Minister of War, but was dismissed and sent home after a remonstrance memorial and later died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Vice Minister of War, but after submitting a remonstrance memorial he was dismissed and returned home, where he later died.

sentences.zh: 世淳，崇禎中舉人。

translations.literal: Shichun passed the provincial examinations during Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun passed the provincial examinations during the Chongzhen reign.

sentences.zh: 十三年冬，歷隨州知州。

translations.literal: In the winter of the thirteenth year he served in turn as magistrate of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the thirteenth year he was appointed magistrate of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 州嘗被賊，居民蕭然。

translations.literal: The prefecture had once been overrun by bandits and the inhabitants were desolate.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture had already been ravaged by bandits, and the people were in dire straits.

sentences.zh: 世淳知賊必復至，集士民誓以死守。

translations.literal: Shichun knew the bandits were sure to return; he gathered gentry and people and swore to defend the city to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun knew the bandits would return; he rallied gentry and townspeople and swore to hold the city to the death.

sentences.zh: 會歲大荒，士多就食粥廠，嘆曰：「可使士以餒失禮乎？

translations.literal: It happened to be a year of great famine and many scholars went to eat at the gruel kitchens; he sighed and said, Can we let scholars lose their propriety through hunger?
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a terrible famine, and many scholars went to the public gruel kitchens. He sighed and said, "Can we let scholars lose their dignity to hunger?

sentences.zh: 」分粟振之。

translations.literal: He distributed grain to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: " He distributed grain to sustain them.

sentences.zh: 潰兵過隨索餉，世淳授兵登陴，而單騎入見軍帥曰：「軍食不供，有司罪也。

translations.literal: Routed troops passing through Suizhou demanded pay; Shichun armed the men and sent them up on the walls, then rode alone to see the army commander and said, If army provisions are not supplied, that is the fault of the officials.
translations.idiomatic: Routed troops passing through Suizhou demanded pay. Shichun armed the militia and sent them to the walls, then rode alone to the army commander and said, "If the army lacks provisions, that is the officials' fault.

sentences.zh: 殺我足矣，請械我以見督師。

translations.literal: Killing me is enough; please bind me and take me before the supervising commander.
translations.idiomatic: Killing me is enough. Please bind me and take me before the supervising commander.

sentences.zh: 」帥氣奪，斂眾去。

translations.literal: The commander's spirit was taken from him and he withdrew his troops and left.
translations.idiomatic: " The commander lost his nerve, gathered his men, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，張獻忠自襄陽來犯，世淳寢食南城譙樓，曉夜固守，告急於巡撫宋一鶴。

translations.literal: The next year, in the third month, Zhang Xianzhong came from Xiangyang to attack; Shichun ate and slept in the south gate watchtower, held firm day and night, and sent urgent word to Grand Coordinator Song Yihe.
translations.idiomatic: The following third month Zhang Xianzhong marched from Xiangyang against the city; Shichun ate and slept in the south gate watchtower, defended day and night, and sent urgent appeals to Grand Coordinator Song Yihe.

sentences.zh: 一鶴遣兵來援，為監司守承天者邀去。

translations.literal: Yihe sent troops to relieve the city, but they were diverted by the supervising official defending Chengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Yihe dispatched relief troops, but they were diverted by the supervising official charged with defending Chengtian.

sentences.zh: 守月余，援絕力窮，賊急攻南城，而潛兵墮北城以入。

translations.literal: After defending for more than a month, relief was cut off and strength exhausted; the bandits pressed the south gate hard while secretly lowering troops over the north wall to enter.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month of defense, relief failed and their strength gave out; the bandits stormed the south gate while secretly lowering men over the north wall to enter the city.

sentences.zh: 世淳命子肇梁{艹}印廨後，勒馬巷戰，矢貫頤，耳鼻橫斷，墜馬，亂刃斫死。

translations.literal: Shichun ordered his son Zhaoliang to bury the seal behind the yamen, then spurred his horse into the lanes to fight; an arrow pierced his cheek, his nose and ears were severed across, he fell from his horse, and was hacked to death in a flurry of blades.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun ordered his son Zhaoliang to bury the seal behind the yamen, then charged into the lanes on horseback; an arrow pierced his cheek, his nose and ears were cut away, he fell from his horse, and was hacked to death.

sentences.zh: 肇梁奔赴，且哭且罵，賊將殺之，呼州人告以{艹}印處，乃死。

translations.literal: Zhaoliang rushed forward, weeping and cursing; the bandit leader was about to kill him, but he called to the townspeople to tell them where the seal was buried, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoliang rushed forward, weeping and cursing; as the bandit leader was about to kill him, he called out to the townspeople to reveal where the seal was buried, and then died.

sentences.zh: 世淳妾趙、王及臧獲十八人皆死。

translations.literal: Shichun's concubines Zhao and Wang and eighteen servants all died.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun's concubines Zhao and Wang and eighteen household servants all perished.

sentences.zh: 後贈太仆少卿，建祠，以肇梁祔。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was built and Zhaoliang was enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously made Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; a shrine was erected and Zhaoliang was worshiped beside him.

sentences.zh: 隨自十年正月陷，及是再陷，至七月復陷，判官余塙死焉。

translations.literal: Suizhou had fallen in the first month of the tenth year; it fell again on this occasion, and fell once more in the seventh month; Vice Magistrate Yu Qian died there.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou had first fallen in the first month of the tenth year; it fell again on this occasion and once more in the seventh month, when Vice Magistrate Yu Qian died.

sentences.zh: 三陷之後，城中幾無孑遺。

translations.literal: After the three falls, scarcely a soul remained in the city.
translations.idiomatic: After falling three times, the city was left with scarcely a survivor.
